name: 돌려차기
action: rear-leg roundhouse kick to the head: pivot on the front foot, turn the hip over, the rear leg swings around and lands its shin at head height, then plant it back into the fighting stance. The body does not spin around. No trails or effects.
prompt: Pivot on the front foot to rotate the hips and swing the rear leg in a wide arc, extending the shin to strike at head height. Retract the leg with controlled momentum, planting the foot firmly back into the initial fighting stance.

name: 스턴
action: fighting game dizzy stun: the guard drops, arms hang limp, knees buckle and the body wobbles on the spot with the head lolling, feet stay planted (no stepping or dancing)
prompt: Drop the guard to hang arms limply at the sides, then buckle the knees slightly while swaying the torso and lolling the head in a dazed rhythm. Finally, stiffen the posture to return to the initial braced fighting stance.

name: 발견 반응
action: startled jolt on spotting an enemy ahead, then turning to face it and raising both fists into a fighting stance
prompt: Jolt in place with a sudden, sharp intake of breath, then pivot rapidly on the heels. Swing the torso around while simultaneously drawing both hands upward, snapping the elbows into a firm, guarded fighting stance.

name: 뒷걸음질
action: walking backward away from a scary enemy in front, still facing the enemy, each foot stepping back behind the body, both open hands raised defensively
prompt: Step backward with deliberate, cautious intent, planting each foot firmly behind the body while maintaining a defensive stance. Keep both open hands raised, trembling slightly, then settle into the original standing position with heels grounded and palms forward.

name: 엎드려 기기
action: injured after being knocked down: roll over from lying on the back onto the stomach, then crawl east on the belly, pulling the body forward with the forearms while the legs drag behind
prompt: Rotate onto the stomach with a labored, heavy twist. Drag the torso forward by digging the forearms into the ground, pulling the dead weight of the legs along the floor until coming to a halt.

name: 주저앉기
action: legs give out from fear and she sinks down slowly to sit on the floor, then sits trembling
prompt: Buckle the knees to collapse downward, descending with heavy, controlled momentum. Transition into a seated position on the floor, keeping the torso upright while initiating a subtle, rhythmic vibration throughout the shoulders to convey persistent trembling.

name: 주저앉아 뒤로 밀려나기
action: sitting on the floor in fear, scooting backward away from the enemy by pushing the floor with both feet, the hips sliding back, hands behind for support, still facing the enemy
prompt: Push backward with both feet to slide the hips across the floor while maintaining support with hands planted behind. Continue the retreat with a rhythmic, bracing motion until coming to a trembling halt.

name: 웅크려 떨기
action: from standing, crouch down and cover the head with both arms in fear, then stay curled up trembling
prompt: Drop quickly into a tight crouch, pulling knees toward the chest while tucking the head down. Bring both arms up to shield the skull, interlocking fingers behind the neck, then settle into a rhythmic, jittery vibration of the shoulders and torso.

name: 네발로 기기
action: from crouching with arms over the head, drop the hands to the floor and crawl away on hands and knees, turning to the east
prompt: Drop the hands to the floor while shifting weight forward onto the knees. Crawl away with a rhythmic, low-slung gait, rotating the upper body to face the side before settling into a low, braced crawl pose.
